title: Wang2016 – SSVEP Wang 2016 dataset
description: A benchmark SSVEP-based brain-computer interface dataset with 64-channel EEG recorded from 35 healthy participants (34 listed in the metadata) who gazed at 40 flickering characters. Targets were coded by joint frequency and phase modulation (8-15.8 Hz in 0.2 Hz steps). Each participant completed 6 blocks of 40 trials with 5 s stimulation. Epochs were downsampled to 250 Hz and distributed as a BIDS derivative.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Synamps2 system (Neuroscan) at 1000 Hz with a 0.15-200 Hz passband and a 50 Hz notch filter, using 64 scalp electrodes with a vertex reference and impedances below 10 kOhm. Stimuli were presented on a 23.6-inch LCD at 60 Hz using sampled sinusoidal stimulation in a 5x8 matrix. Each 6 s trial had a 0.5 s cue, 5 s flicker and 0.5 s blank. Continuous data were epoched around stimulus onsets and downsampled to 250 Hz with no digital filtering.
